prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: 1920×1080 Remotion paper-collage style approval master plate
Primary request: Create a restrained, poetic Chinese xuan-paper collage tableau for 《庄周梦蝶》. It must show two separate symbolic paper subjects: Zhuang Zhou on the left and one complete butterfly on the right, with a broad clean circular negative-space zone between them for later code-rendered graphics and text.
Scene/backdrop: moon-white handmade xuan paper, subtle visible fibers, torn layered edges, faint dark teal ink wash and sparse mist, understated moonlit atmosphere.
Subject: left side, a single seated profile silhouette of an ancient Chinese scholar in a loose pre-Qin cross-collar robe and simple cloth cap, calm posture, complete head profile, torso, wide sleeves and both hands; right side, a single elegant butterfly made from gold and mineral-blue paper, complete body, two antennae, two full symmetrical wing pairs with continuous edges.
Style/medium: handcrafted cut-paper collage with restrained Song-Yuan ink-painting sensibility, tactile paper fibers, shallow layered shadow, elegant negative space, not photorealistic, not cartoonish.
Composition/framing: cinematic 16:9; scholar occupies roughly the left 15–34%, butterfly the right 70–86%; keep the central 36–66% clean and quiet; keep the bottom 18% visually calm for subtitle safety.
Lighting/mood: soft moonlit paper shadows, contemplative, quiet, open-ended.
Color palette: moon white, dark teal, muted warm umber, restrained mineral blue and antique gold only on the butterfly.
Constraints: keep Zhuang Zhou and butterfly visibly separate; preserve all named silhouette parts and internal negative spaces; no connecting ribbon or literal morph; no extra people, animals, insects, props, flowers, buildings, sun, modern objects, logos or brands.
Avoid: absolutely no text, letters, Chinese characters, punctuation, seals, stamps, diagrams, circles, arrows, watermark, signature, border, frame, grotesque human-butterfly hybrid, extra limbs, extra wings, missing antennae, broken paper edges across the central negative space.
